package.name: nuxeo-advanced-document-blob-audit
package.title: Nuxeo Advanced Document Blob Audit
package.description:
Audits what actually changed inside a binary - Excel cell by cell, Word and PDF paragraph by paragraph, text line by line - and stores the diff in a dedicated, access-restricted BlobDiff document rather than in the audit log or on the source document.
Disabled by default. Enable and scope it through the "config" extension point of org.nuxeo.audit.advanced.blob.BlobDiffComponent before using it in production: diffing binaries is costly, and it copies business content into a document whose permissions differ from the source.
Standalone: does not depend on nuxeo-advanced-document-audit.
